system.name: SpatioLM
system.one_liner: Parameter-efficient plug-in module that elicits spatial knowledge in a VLM, supervised by pseudo depth and camera information, without 3D inputs or external encoders.

content.variant_note: four grey-tabbed panels (data and model, perception, understanding, manipulation); each capability panel pairs real question-answer bubbles with a radar or bar chart of scores
content.argues: One spatial module in a VLM reaches state-of-the-art perception and understanding scores and transfers to robot manipulation with both discrete and continuous actions.
content.subject: Data and model sketch, question-answer cards with radar charts, and manipulation variants with action outputs and a bar chart.

lessons.what_to_learn: Use one accent colour for everything that belongs to the method, and give each capability a grey-tabbed panel that pairs one or two real question-answer bubbles with a small chart of scores against the best existing model; a data-and-model panel states the scale in outlined headline boxes over a faded thumbnail mosaic.
lessons.suits: General-purpose model papers whose claim is breadth: several capabilities, each shown by real examples plus a radar or bar summary.

evidence: SpatioLM achieves SOTA performance on both spatial perception and understanding tasks
can be effectively adapted to embodied manipulation tasks under both discrete and continuous action settings.
a parameter-efficient framework that improves spatial intelligence in VLMs without extra 3D prior inputs or external spatial encoders.

summary: SpatioLM is a parameter-efficient framework that improves spatial intelligence in vision-language models without extra 3D inputs or external spatial encoders. Figure 1 tiles four grey-tabbed panels. 'Data & Model' states 20K videos, 643K QA pairs and 15 datasets over a faded thumbnail mosaic, above an orange Spatio-Vision Module beside a grey Large Language Model with rows of coloured token squares and image, video and text inputs. 'Spatial Perception' and 'Spatial Understanding' pair real question and answer bubbles with radar charts of SpatioLM against the best of 13 existing models (VSI-Bench 71.6). 'Downstream – Manipulation' shows discrete and continuous action variants, action tokens, predicted frames and a LIBERO bar chart.
summary_zh: SpatioLM 在不加 3D 输入的前提下增强 VLM 的空间智能。图 1 由四个灰标签面板拼成：数据与模型、空间感知、空间理解、下游操控，每格配真实问答气泡与雷达图或柱状图，橙色统一代表本方法。
notes: No paragraph of the paper that mentions the figure was available, so roles come from the caption, abstract and the figure's own labels. The colours of the token squares and the dark squares in the OFT action strip are not keyed, so they are recorded as drawn. There are no arrowheads in the SVG; the Data & Model flow is read from position. Pre-screen scope-overview and stage-pipeline were dropped: the figure is not about a benchmark and has no process chain.
